newsitem.title: JAPAN: Santen slips on earnings disappointment.
newsitem.headline: Santen slips on earnings disappointment.

text.p: Santen Pharmaceutical Co Ltd slipped on Thursday afternoon, after the firm's earnings proved to be below market expectations, brokers said.
As of 0403 GMT, the shares were down 380 yen or 15.51 percent at 2,070. Santen was the largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

Santen said earlier in the day that its parent current profit for the 1996/97 year ended March 31 was 17.66 billion yen against 16.76 billion in the previous year. It forecast a parent current profit of 13.50 billion yen for the 1997/98 year.
